label: AbiK system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses an abiK locus encoding a reverse-transcriptase-related polymerase that uses conserved RT motifs for phage resistance and restricts 936/P335 lactococcal phage propagation.
observations: AbiK branch under abortive infection system; distinct from individual abiK genes, AbiK proteins, AbiK RT motifs or polymerase activity without direct Abi evidence, phage Sak escape proteins, AbiA systems, AbiE systems, AbiQ systems, ToxIN systems, AbiZ systems, generic abortive infection systems, and source database rows naming one Abi locus.
